articles.title: 18 injured in suspected arson at Mississauga apartment building
articles.summary: Residents in a Mississauga apartment building are shaken after a fire Monday morning, which police say may have been arson, sent at least 18 people to the hospital, including a firefighter and a police officer.

articles.title: 1 person injured in North York car crash
articles.summary: One person was sent to a hospital late Monday afternoon following a car crash in North York. Emergency crews were called to the area of Islington and Steeles Avenues just before 5:30 p.m. for reports of a two-vehicle collision. articles.title: Man, 19, facing charges for allegedly threatening to carry out a shooting at a Durham Region synagogue
articles.summary: A 19-year-old man is facing charges for allegedly threatening to carry out a shooting at a synagogue in Durham Region. Durham police say they received information on Friday from an extrernal law enforcement partner about threats made on an online message board. articles.title: Watermain replacement work closes lanes on portion of University Avenue until spring 2027
articles.summary: Long-delayed work to replace watermains along University Avenue began Monday, kicking off extended lane restrictions along a portion of the busy street until next spring. The City of Toronto says it plans to replace the watermain as well as the portion of “substandard” water services owned by the City on the east side of University […]

articles.title: 2 dead after shooting outside Scarborough seniors' medical centre: police
articles.summary: Two people are dead following a shooting outside a seniors’ medical centre in Scarborough Monday afternoon, Toronto police say.

articles.title: Peel Regional Police Association endorses Alvin Tedjo in Mississauga mayoral race
articles.summary: The association is endorsing a candidate in Mississauga’s municipal campaign for what the organization says is the first time in its history. The Peel police union's president said Monday that Tedjo "understands that public safety is not just a slogan, it's a responsibility."

articles.title: 2 people, believed to be married couple, dead in Scarborough daylight shooting
articles.summary: Two people in their 70s who were believed to have been married have died in a shooting in Scarborough Monday afternoon. articles.title: Peel police union backs Alvin Tedjo in first ever endorsement of Mississauga mayoral candidate
articles.summary: In their first endorsement of a mayoral candidate ever, the Peel Regional Police Association (PRPA) has endorsed Alvin Tedjo to become the next mayor of Mississauga. articles.title: Ontario launches project to refurbish 4 nuclear reactors at Pickering plant
articles.summary: An Ontario nuclear plant is beginning a massive refurbishment project today, as Premier Doug Ford's government looks to lean heavily on nuclear energy to serve the province's growing electricity needs.
